default_port.description: Fallback serial port used when the BNO08X_UART_RVC_PORT env var is unset.

baudrate.description: UART baud rate for the BNO08x RVC link (typically 115200).

poll_rate_hz.description: Rate in Hz at which the driver's background thread reads IMU data.

serial_timeout.description: Driver-internal timing (see src/hardware/imu/bno08x/uart_rvc.py): a raw pyserial read/thread-join timeout, and how long to wait for new data.

data_lock_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a new IMU reading before treating the data as unavailable.

euler_sequence.description: Order in which the RVC Euler angles are interpreted during quaternion conversion (one of xyz, zyx, xzy, yzx, zxy, yxz).

negate_yaw.description: Negate yaw so counterclockwise rotation is positive in the ROS 2 frame for this mount.

negate_pitch.description: Negate pitch so nose-up is positive in the ROS 2 frame for this mount.

negate_roll.description: Negate roll so banking right is positive in the ROS 2 frame for this mount.

vid.description: USB vendor ID of the MCP2221A bridge, as a hex string.

pid.description: USB product ID of the MCP2221A bridge, as a hex string.
